verifier_note: Verified against rustc 1.98.1, rapier3d-f64 0.35.3, parry3d-f64 0.30.2 and dlmalloc 0.2.13 read on disk; si-rpg-engine's live GitHub state (main, open PR #44 'slice-t3-platforms' stacked on open PR #43, and the T3/T4 dispatch docs); and every external source (WebAssembly 3.0 spec, relaxed-simd proposal, LLD docs, rustc/Cargo book, Rust Reference, Wasmtime docs, rapier CHANGELOG/user guide, docs.rs). Ran all 19 checks embedded in this lane through compile_oracle.py check against the real pinned toolchain and dependencies: 19/19 passed, including the exact controller-limit reproduction (0.29-0.31 climbed, 0.311/0.32 stopped, engine's real STEP_HEIGHT/STEP_MIN_WIDTH/SKIN constants) and the exact --no-growable-memory / misaligned-initial-memory linker-argument reproductions. Every one of the ~45 warrant sources resolved and supported its claim; every cited rapier/parry/dlmalloc file:line matched, down to operator-level detail (is_wall uses >=, the stairs landing check uses strict >, snap uses <=0). Engine facts hold up to a subtle test: PR #44's actual current code fixes wasm memory at 256 pages (16 MiB) in both config.toml and build.mjs, matching recipes 1 and 2 exactly, NOT the 512-page figure in the same-day-amended dispatch pin 10 that recipe 2 also cites separately and correctly as a distinct, not-yet-implemented recommendation. Systemic weakness: nearly every engine_note anchors to an open, unmerged, stacked PR (#44 depends on #43, both open) and to dispatch docs that were amended same-day from KB answers; this is accurate today (2026-09-25) but is a moving target that goes stale the moment either branch merges, rebases, or is amended again, and a handful of dense-scene page-count figures (e.g. 49/147/3,320 pages; the 1,117,808-byte linker error) are the research agent's own unreproduced measurements, taken on faith rather than independently re-run in this pass.
